primary_failure_mode_caught: Operational topology, health checks, observability, runtime dependencies, and service ownership are missing from project discovery.

assumptions.posture: Infer service topology and operability facts from configuration and runbooks, while separating declared state from observed state.

required_inputs: health check and smoke test scripts
must_not: claim live service health without runtime evidence
treat monitoring config as proof alerts are active
ignore missing runbooks or ownership metadata
